units.source_text: 掸海和尚盘腿坐在正殿客殿的十二铺席宽的房间里，品尝副司精心备好的酒和下酒的素斋。

en.t: Priest Zen海 sat cross-legged in the twelve-mat room of the main hall's guest quarters, savoring the wine and vegetarian dishes that the vice steward had carefully prepared to go with it.

units.source_text: 我来之前，是师兄弟给他斟酒；我到之后，就由我替代。

en.t: Before I came, one of my fellow disciples poured his wine; after I arrived, I took his place.

units.source_text: 我端坐在禅海和尚面前为他斟酒。

en.t: I sat upright before Priest Zen海 and poured wine for him.

units.source_text: 我背何下着无声的菲菲的细雨的黑夜。

en.t: Behind me lay the black night, with a fine, soundless drizzle falling steadily.

units.source_text: 禅海和尚所能望见的，只能是我的脸和这梅雨季节的庭院里的黑夜。

en.t: All Priest Zen海 could see was my face and the darkness of the garden in this rainy season.

units.source_text: 也就是说，所能望及的就是这两样黑暗的东西，别无其他。

en.t: In other words, those two dark things were all that came within sight, and there was nothing else.
